title: Perfect direct image over a Noetherian base
statement: Let S be Noetherian, let f:X\to S be of finite presentation [def-pc-morphism-conventions], let E_i be perfect on X [def-pc-perfect-complex], and let G^\bullet be bounded, finitely presented, flat over S, with proper support [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then Rf_*(E_i\otimes^L G^\bullet) [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is perfect on S [def-pc-perfect-complex].

proof.text: Finite presentation implies locally finite type. Mathlib LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian gives locally Noetherian X. QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace gives compact X from Noetherian S, so X is Noetherian. For each term G^n, finite presentation supplies quasi-coherence and finite type by Mathlib instances; apply isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType to obtain coherence.
Apply perfect_tensor_bounded_coherent to E and the bounded termwise coherent G; destruct its conjunction to get bounded and coherent cohomology of E tensor^L Q(G).

Apply boundedComplex_tensor_proper_support_bound to get one proper closed Z containing every cohomology support. For each cohomology sheaf H, use isCoherent_iff_isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType to obtain quasi-coherence and finite type, and finite_type_module_support_closed to bundle its nonzero-stalk locus as a closed Y. The containment gives Y <= Z, so the third conjunct of closed_subset_proper_over_base_properties shows Y proper. The witness Y, reflexive equality with the nonzero-stalk locus, and this properness proof give HasSupportProperOver for H. The final existential witness unfolds the definition HasSupportProperOver [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base].
Apply perfect_tensor_hasFiniteTorDimensionOver to the compact X, E perfect, bounded G and termwise relative flatness. This supplies finite relative Tor dimension of E tensor^L Q(G).

Apply isPerfect_schemeDerivedDirectImage_of_bounded_coherent_finiteTor (08EV) to E tensor^L Q(G), using the bounds, coherence, proper supports and relative Tor dimension just proved. Its conclusion is the original theorem, with every original binder and universe unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem noetherian_perfect_directImage {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))] (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : Scheme.IsPerfect X E) (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (hGb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n)) [∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFinitePresentation] (hGflat : ∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.IsFlatOver (G.X n) f) (hGproper : ∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.X n)) : Scheme.IsPerfect S ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G))
